items.title: Show HN: A collaborative music making game that teaches music as you play
items.contentSnippet:
Jam is a music making game that runs in the browser. You start with one instrument, and you write parts on a piano roll. Create your own music or play gigs (levels) to ear coin and buy more gear. Each gig is built around one musical idea, so you pick up some music knowledge as you go. Friends can join your studio with a link and write parts alongside you.

items.title: Show HN: erXos – a microkernel OS in Erlang based on Genera/Plan 9/QNX ideas
items.contentSnippet:
What if every Erlang process were an operating-system process? With as much system code and drivers written in Erlang itself. This is something I was pondering for a while, and finally was able to prototype thanks to AI coding agents.
erXos is a capability-based microkernel OS in Erlang: drivers, filesystems, and the network stack are all supervised Erlang processes, same as any app.
